name: Speechify Simba 3.5
access: Speechify API on every plan: POST /v1/audio/speech, POST /v1/audio/stream, POST /v1/audio/stream/with-timestamps and the WebSocket input stream GET /v1/audio/stream/ws, model simba-3.5; not the default, so a request must name it [sp-chlog-1018] [sp-models-1031]
Not on POST /v1/audio/dialogue, which stays on simba-dialogue-1.0 [sp-chlog-1018]

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text or SSML. It applies break, prosody rate, pitch and volume, and sub alias; it accepts emphasis and speechify:style emotion tags and does not apply them. An optional pronunciations list (IPA or alias, up to 200 entries) works in every language except English [sp-ssml-1031] [sp-chlog-1018] [sp-chlog-1020]
voice.output_audio: The 23 `output_format` values of the API: PCM at 8 to 48 kHz, mu-law at 8 kHz, MP3 at 22.05 and 24 kHz (the 192 kbps values are delivered at 160 kbps), Ogg, AAC and WAV at 24 kHz, and WAV at 48 kHz; WAV is not on the streaming routes [sp-formats-1031]
voice.voices: every catalogue voice and every zero-shot clone made on a paid plan, with the same voice id in each of the 48 languages; a voice keeps the accent of its source recording, so the maker advises a voice native to the target language [sp-models-1031] [sp-lang-1031]
voice.latency: The maker reports 72 ms time to first audio for 95% of streaming requests under production load, for English, as of October 2026 [sp-blog-35]. The maker's latency guide has rows for simba-3.2 only [sp-latency-1031]
voice.session_limit: 2,000 spoken characters per /v1/audio/speech request (20,000 as sent, markup included) and 20,000 spoken characters per streaming request (32,000 as sent); a WebSocket session ends after 60 seconds idle and stops taking text after 5 minutes [sp-limits-1031] [sp-ws]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, drawn from a plan's US dollar balance. List price US$20 per 1M characters on Starter, US$16 on Pro and US$12 on Scale, twice the rate of Simba 3.2 and 3.0; until 2026-11-21 it bills at US$10, US$8 and US$6. At list price the Free balance buys 250K characters a month and Starter 950K; SSML tags are not billed [sp-chlog-1021] [sp-pricing-1031] [sp-blog-35]

benchmarks.name: Maker blind side-by-side listening preference over Simba 3.2 (English, percent of comparisons)
benchmarks.setting: US and UK English listeners, all content, 95% CI 60 to 67%, as of October 2026; the method is in a fact sheet this card did not read

benchmarks.name: Maker blind listening preference over Simba 3.0 Multilingual (six shared locales, percent of comparisons)
benchmarks.setting: native listeners in the six locales both models speak, as of October 2026

benchmarks.name: Maker time to first audio, p95 (milliseconds)
benchmarks.setting: English streaming requests under production load, as of October 2026

sources.quote: `simba-3.5` speaks 48 languages under one model id, on every plan, up from the six that `simba-3.0` covers.
Until 21 November 2026 it bills at their rates instead: $10, $8 and $6.
